remarks: Experience luxury living at its finest in this exquisite direct waterfront property that has been completely renovated by award winning builder. Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 6 bedroom 6.5 bathroom one of a kind property that will take your breath away from the moment you walk through the front door. Built with the best finishes in mind, you'll enjoy 10ft+ ceilings, flexible open floor plan, private office, walls of large-pane oversized glass with breathtaking water views, and formal rooms that flow seamlessly from one to another. Entertaining is easy in the ultimate dream kitchen featuring two islands with 2"quartz countertops, chefs appliances, two dishwashers, wine fridge, custom walk-in pantry, wet bar, and dramatic windowed breakfast area that opens to the family room overlooking the fabulous deck with unobstructed views of the lake. Wide plank floors, custom staircase with glass railings, and cubie built-ins will show the attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with sitting are, huge walk-in closet, private deck and spa like bathroom featuring heated floors, double sink vanity and beautiful shower w/ frameless glass door. (All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms with heated floors). Head Downstairs to a beautifully finished walkout lower level with full kitchen, additional bedroom, full bath, media room, game room, Gym, and 2nd laundry. The perfect space for au-pair quarters or in-law suite.
